oathraXPosts.text:
An AI saying "booked" is not proof.

Oathra now runs its real completion checker in your browser. Try a vague reply, confirm the booking, then retract it. Watch the result change.

No API key. Your text stays local. Open source.
https://t.co/V9qwQv04wy https://t.co/ilIilxRRlM

AIの「予約できました」を、そのまま信じない。

Oathraにブラウザで動く証拠ラボを追加しました。
「たぶん」→未完了
「承りました」→完了
「やはり取れません」→未完了

自分の言葉でも試せます。APIキー不要。
https://t.co/7pgW9ksONK https://t.co/psA7TrIGtW

interpretation: The two Oathra X posts have no replies or likes at this observation. Reported impressions are 0 (JA) and 1 (EN); this is not a count of external trial users.

Current priority: eligible distribution and real feedback. Do not attribute a later star change to one post without evidence.
